tools.name: spain_beckham_law
tools.description: Compares take-home pay in Spain in 2026 under the Beckham Law special regime for people moving to Spain (24% flat up to EUR 600,000, 47% above) and under the normal income tax regime, for a gross annual employment salary. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/beckham-law-calculator/

tools.name: us_net_salary
tools.description: US take-home pay in 2026 for a single filer with the standard deduction: federal income tax plus Social Security (6.2% up to $184,500) and Medicare (1.45%, +0.9% above $200,000). No state income tax. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/us-salary-in-spain/

tools.name: dubai_salary_in_spain
tools.description: For a monthly salary in Dubai (no income tax), the gross annual salary needed in Spain in 2026 to take home the same amount. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/dubai-salary-in-spain/

tools.name: spanish_salary_in_dubai
tools.description: For a gross annual salary in Spain, the monthly Dubai salary (AED) that leaves the same take-home pay, and how much more is kept if the same gross is paid in Dubai. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/spanish-salary-in-dubai/

tools.name: us_salary_in_spain
tools.description: For a US gross annual salary, the gross salary needed in Spain in 2026 to take home the same (US federal tax + FICA, no state tax; Spain single, no children). Source: https://borbur.net/tools/us-salary-in-spain/

tools.name: spanish_salary_in_the_us
tools.description: For a gross annual salary in Spain, the US salary that leaves the same take-home pay in a state with no income tax. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/spanish-salary-in-the-us/

tools.name: uk_net_salary
tools.description: UK take-home pay in 2026/27 (England, Wales, Northern Ireland): income tax (personal allowance £12,570, tapered above £100,000; 20%, 40%, 45%) and employee National Insurance (8% to £50,270, 2% above). Source: https://borbur.net/tools/uk-salary-in-spain/

tools.name: uk_salary_in_spain
tools.description: For a UK gross annual salary, the gross salary needed in Spain in 2026 to take home the same (UK 2026/27 income tax + NI; Spain single, no children). Source: https://borbur.net/tools/uk-salary-in-spain/

tools.name: spanish_salary_in_the_uk
tools.description: For a Spanish gross annual salary in euros, the UK salary that leaves the same take-home pay (Spain 2026; UK 2026/27 income tax + NI, England, Wales, Northern Ireland). Source: https://borbur.net/tools/spanish-salary-in-the-uk/

tools.name: canada_net_salary
tools.description: Canadian take-home pay in 2026 in Ontario for a single employee: federal and Ontario income tax (with the Ontario surtax and Health Premium), CPP, CPP2 and Employment Insurance. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/canada-salary-in-dubai/

tools.name: canada_salary_in_dubai
tools.description: For a Canadian (Ontario) gross annual salary, the Dubai salary in AED that leaves the same take-home pay (no income tax in the UAE). Ontario 2026 rules, single employee. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/canada-salary-in-dubai/

tools.name: dubai_salary_in_canada
tools.description: For a monthly Dubai salary in AED (tax-free), the gross annual salary needed in Ontario, Canada, in 2026 to take home the same. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/dubai-salary-in-canada/

tools.name: uae_gratuity
tools.description: UAE private-sector end-of-service gratuity under Federal Decree-Law 33 of 2021: 21 days of basic salary per year for the first 5 years, 30 days per year after, capped at 2 years of basic salary. Give years of service or days of service. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/uae-gratuity-calculator/

tools.name: dhondt_seats
tools.description: Shares out seats with the D'Hondt method as in Spain's general elections (3% threshold over valid votes, blank votes count as valid). Give a Spanish province (its 2026 Congress seats are used) or a number of seats, and the votes per party. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/dhondt-calculator/
